question: Which classes of beings are listed alongside the deities in this context?
premises: Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas and Vidyādharas are listed.
The list is addressed to the beloved.
inference: A further set of semi-divine beings falls under the same context as the deities.
uncertainties: Their specific relation to the practice is presupposed from context.
plain_english: O beloved, Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakṣas, Nāgas and Vidyādharas are included.
